arguments.summary: Rewrote slugify in src/lib.rs (lowercase, drop non-alphanumerics, collapse runs to single hyphen, trim edges), which fixes punctuation_is_dropped, runs_collapse, edges_trim, and spaces_become_hyphens. spaces_become_underscores cannot pass: it asserts slugify("Hello World") == "hello_world" while spaces_become_hyphens asserts the same call == "hello-world" — a direct contradiction for a pure deterministic function, so no implementation can satisfy both. Did not modify tests/slug.rs per instructions.
